approval_basis: Owner approved continued Phase 2 commerce cohesion refactoring on 2026-08-27 with behavior-preserving slices merged to main after verification.

REQ-001.proof: Order-facing service behavior remains in package commerce behind the existing Service facade, with no route, API payload, Store contract, authorization, state-machine, idempotency, persistence, or runtime contract change.

AC-001.proof: Existing order query/masking, checkout, order status, return status, and restock method bodies are relocated into cohesion-oriented service files while preserving signatures and call order.

REQ-002.proof: The central service.go no longer owns the contiguous order service implementation; order lookup/status, checkout, returns, and restock responsibilities are colocated in dedicated files within package commerce.

AC-002.proof: The refactor introduces no new module, interface, provider, database migration, SQL change, UI change, or refund capability and retains existing fail-closed refund gating.
